title: Complete tree from a partial input
statement: Given a function from the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube to a set of outputs, a partial input, and a set of available coordinates, recursively construct a decision tree as follows: if any coordinates remain available, query the least one, and continue on the two branches after setting that coordinate to $0$ or $1$ and removing it from the available set. If none remain, make a leaf labelled by the value of the function at the current input.
hypotheses_covered: a function from the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube to an output type
a partial input in the Boolean cube
a finite set of available coordinates
